title: FRANKIE GRANDE X TITANIQUE X SPOTIFY ALERT! We are getting @FrankieJG...
transcript: Hi, everybody. It's me, the captain of the ship. Do y'all have fun tonight? I wanted to give you guys a little sneak peek because we are here at Spotify X Titanic. So I wonder what I could play for you guys that maybe could be releasing on April 20 and streaming on Spotify X Titanic. That may have something to do with the show. I don't know. Why don't we just listen to it, everybody? Yes! Yeah! Hey, hey, hey, hey! I've been waiting for you all night.
classificationReason: Frankie Grande at a Spotify x Titanique promotional event teasing a new release on April 20. Promotional/announcement content, not a first-hand review of the stage production.
